top_jobs.job: When someone on the team or at the agency wants to run a discount or change an offer, help me see what it costs in gross profit, how many extra orders it needs, the new most we can pay per purchase, and whether the ad, page and cart all show the same offer, so I do not give away the month's profit
top_jobs.metric: gross profit per order during offers against normal weeks

top_jobs.job: When sales only come during promotions and every visitor gets a code, help me see how much revenue depends on discounts and which discounts go to buyers who would have bought anyway, so I stop training buyers to wait
top_jobs.metric: share of revenue on a discount code, new vs returning

top_jobs.job: When order size is stuck and shoppers hesitate, help me raise order value and remove the biggest doubt with thresholds, bundles, gifts and guarantees that still clear the margin floor, so each order earns more without a deeper discount
top_jobs.metric: gross profit per order and average order value

top_jobs.job: When a tariff, freight or supplier cost rise lands, or a new product needs a price, help me choose between raising price, changing the pack or absorbing it, using real costs and the rival range, so margin holds without losing buyers
top_jobs.metric: gross margin percent on the top 10 SKUs

top_jobs.job: When Black Friday or a rival's big sale is coming, or an offer has gone stale, help me plan an answer that adds profit and does not just pull orders forward or match their price, so the season lifts the year
top_jobs.metric: season gross profit against normal weeks, counting the dip after

jobs.job: Cost every proposed discount before it runs: gross profit per order at that depth, extra orders needed to break even, and a yes or no against the margin floor
jobs.trigger: every time someone proposes a discount, before it goes live

inputs.need: baseline orders per day for the products in the offer
the proposal: products, depth, dates, channels
margin floor and deepest discount allowed

steps: Take the products, depth and dates from the proposal
Compute gross profit per order at full price and at the offer
Compute the extra orders needed to make the same gross profit
Compare with lift from past offers of the same depth
Write yes, no or change, with the numbers, and log it
jobs.output: a 1 page offer cost sheet with break even orders and a yes, no or change
jobs.next: feeds 04-03 (new max cost per purchase) and 04-04 (sale review)

watch.metric: gross profit per order during offers

jobs.job: Write discount rules the founder signs: deepest discount per product, a never discount list, how often, who may make codes, and check every live code against them each week

inputs.need: all live codes with creator and depth

steps: Draft rules from margins, rival habits and the founder's limits
Founder signs and the rules go on the offers shelf
List live codes and check each against the rules
Flag breaking codes with who made them and margin given away
Turn off or fix breaking codes with the founder's yes
jobs.output: signed discount rules and a weekly list of codes that break them

jobs.job: Send the media buyer the new most we can pay per purchase, per product, the day an offer or price changes
jobs.trigger: the day any price, offer or cost changes
steps: Recompute gross profit per first order at the new price
Add expected repeat profit where the founder allows it
Set the most we can pay per purchase, first order and with repeat
Send both numbers to the media buyer and the ad screens
Log the change date
jobs.output: a cost per purchase target per product with the date it changed
jobs.next: feeds 11 paid social and 12 Google ads targets

watch.metric: ads judged against the current target

jobs.job: Review every sale 3 weeks after it ends: the 2 weeks before, the sale and the 3 weeks after against a normal baseline, and record whether to run it again

inputs.need: orders and gross profit by day, 8 weeks around the sale

steps: Set a baseline from normal weeks
Sum gross profit above baseline in the sale and below baseline before and after
Split new vs returning buyers in the sale
Write the true lift and whether to run it again
File in the offer archive and the ledger
jobs.output: a sale review with true lift, new buyer share and a run again call

watch.metric: gross profit per sale against baseline

jobs.job: Show promo dependence each month for 24 months: share of revenue and orders on a code, split new vs returning

inputs.need: orders with codes and discounts, 24 months

steps: Sum revenue on a code and at full price per month
Split each by new and returning buyers
Plot share on a code over 24 months
Mark months where full price sales fell as code sales rose
Write the trend in 1 line
jobs.output: a 24 month chart of discount share, new vs returning

watch.metric: share of revenue on a code

jobs.job: Find codes leaked to coupon sites and browser extensions from the referrer on each order, shut them and swap in unique codes

inputs.need: orders with code, referrer and UTM
list of coupon sites and extensions
inputs.from: a public list, kept in a Google Sheet

inputs.need: which codes are meant to be public

steps: List codes used by orders from coupon sites or with no source
Mark codes not meant to be public
Sum discount given away on those orders
Turn them off and issue unique codes for their true purpose
Check next week for new leaks
jobs.output: a leak list with dollars given away and codes swapped

jobs.job: Test the welcome pop-up offer: hold back 20 percent of new visitors from the discount for 4 weeks and compare conversion and gross profit per visitor

inputs.need: pop-up tool with a hold back option
orders and margin per visitor group

steps: Set a 20 percent hold back with no discount, email capture kept
Run 4 weeks or until the sample size is met
Compare conversion, order value and gross profit per visitor
Write keep, cut the depth, or swap for a non cash reward
Log in the ledger
jobs.output: a pop-up test result with gross profit per visitor for each group

jobs.job: Test the first cart reminder with and without a discount, and keep the discount only if it adds gross profit
steps: Split the first reminder: no discount vs current discount
Keep later reminders the same
Run 4 weeks
Compare recovered orders and gross profit per cart
Keep the winner and log it
jobs.output: a reminder test result and the kept version

jobs.job: Stop giving loyal buyers new customer codes: count returning buyers using welcome codes, and replace their discount with early access or a gift

inputs.need: orders with codes and new vs returning flag

steps: Count returning buyers who used welcome or new customer codes
Sum the discount given to them
Limit welcome codes to first orders
Offer returning buyers early access or a gift instead
Track repeat rate for 90 days
jobs.output: a count of discount to loyal buyers and a new loyal offer

jobs.job: Set the free shipping line from the order value spread and shipping cost per order, pick the line that lifts order size and pays for itself, and test it
jobs.trigger: once, then when shipping rates change
steps: Plot the order value spread and find the peaks
Test 3 lines 15 to 30 percent above the median order
Cost each: shipping paid vs extra gross profit from buyers moving up
Pick the best and run it for 4 weeks
Compare order value and gross profit per order
jobs.output: a chosen free shipping line with a 4 week result

jobs.job: Build 3 bundles from products bought together, price each to keep gross profit per order above the floor, and launch on the top product pages

inputs.need: pack and price per unit issues from buyers

steps: Find the top pairs and sets in baskets
Pick 3 bundles that fit a buyer job
Price each so gross profit per order beats the average
Add to the top product pages
Read attach rate and order value for 4 weeks
jobs.output: 3 live bundles with prices and a 4 week read

watch.metric: bundle attach rate and order value

jobs.job: Test a free gift at an order value tier against 10 percent off, and keep the one with more gross profit per visitor

inputs.need: a split test tool or a split by week

steps: Pick a tier just above the most common order value
Pick a gift that costs less than the discount it replaces
Run gift vs 10 percent off for 4 weeks
Compare conversion, order value and gross profit per visitor
Keep the winner and log it
jobs.output: a gift vs discount result with the kept offer

jobs.job: Build an offer around the biggest doubt from the objection ladder, such as a fit guarantee or a trial, and cost it at the expected claim rate

inputs.need: top doubt from the objection ladder

steps: Pick the doubt that costs the most sales
Write 2 offers that remove it
Cost each at the claim rate and at 2 times that rate
Put the best on the product page and in ads
Read conversion and claims for 6 weeks
jobs.output: a costed doubt offer, live, with a 6 week read

jobs.job: Check every week that each live ad's offer matches its landing page, cart and emails, and fix mismatches before buyers see them
jobs.trigger: every Monday and before any offer launch

inputs.need: live ads with copy and URLs

steps: List every offer claim in live ads
Open each landing page and cart and read the offer shown
Check emails sent this week for the same offer
Flag mismatches with spend on the ad
Send fixes to the owner the same day
jobs.output: a weekly offer match list with mismatches fixed
jobs.next: feeds 07 landing pages and 11 paid social

jobs.job: When a cost rise lands, compare raising price, changing the pack and absorbing it for each SKU hit, in gross profit per month at 3 levels of buyer loss
jobs.trigger: the week a cost rise lands
steps: List SKUs hit and the cost change per unit
Model 3 options for each: raise price, change pack, absorb
For each, compute gross profit per month at 0, 5 and 10 percent fewer buyers
Check each new price against the rival band
Founder picks; log the reason
jobs.output: an option table per SKU with a founder pick
jobs.next: feeds 04-16 (price test) and 04-03 (new cost per purchase target)

jobs.job: Test a price rise of 5 to 10 percent on 1 product for 4 weeks and read conversion and gross profit per visitor

inputs.need: price test tool or a before and after plan

steps: Pick a product with steady traffic and room in its band
Raise the price on all channels at once
Run 4 weeks
Compare conversion and gross profit per visitor with the 4 weeks before
Keep, roll back, or move to the next product
jobs.output: a price test result and a keep or roll back call

watch.metric: gross profit per visitor on the product

jobs.job: Price a new product from 3 numbers: landed cost floor, the rival band, and what 100 buyers say is cheap, fair and too much

inputs.need: a 4 question price survey to 100 buyers

steps: Compute the floor price for the target margin
Read the rival band for the product
Survey 100 buyers: too cheap, a bargain, getting pricey, too much
Pick a price in the overlap of all 3
Set the cost per purchase target at that price
jobs.output: a launch price with the 3 numbers behind it
jobs.next: feeds 04-03 (cost per purchase target) and 01-17 (90 day review)

watch.metric: gross margin and conversion in the first 30 days

jobs.job: When an offer stops working, refresh it in order: new creative, then new copy, then a new wrapper or name, then new length, before any deeper discount
jobs.trigger: when an offer's conversion falls 20 percent from its first 4 weeks
steps: Confirm the drop is the offer, not traffic or stock
Swap creative first and read 2 weeks
Then copy, then the name or wrapper, then the end date
Only then cost a deeper discount
Log what brought it back
jobs.output: a refreshed offer and a note on which step worked

jobs.job: Plan the Black Friday offer 8 weeks out: read the last 2 years, cost 3 offer shapes, pick one that adds profit after the dip, and check stock

inputs.need: stock by SKU and lead times

steps: Read true lift from the last 2 sales, counting the dip
Cost 3 shapes: sitewide percent off, gift tiers, bundles
Pick the shape with the most gross profit above baseline
Check stock covers the plan and order now if not
Set dates for creative, emails and page, and put them on the board
jobs.output: a costed sale plan with stock check and dates
jobs.next: feeds 09 creative, 14 email and 00 Today board

watch.metric: gross profit in sale weeks against baseline

jobs.job: Answer a rival's big sale within 24 hours without matching their price: add a gift, a bundle or a longer guarantee that costs less than their discount
jobs.trigger: within 24 hours of a rival sale alert
steps: Read which of our products the rival sale touches
Cost a gift, a bundle and a guarantee against their discount
Pick the one with the lowest cost per order
Brief 1 ad and 1 email with the answer
Read our sales on those products for 7 days
jobs.output: a live value answer with its cost and a 7 day read

new_enablers.name: Offer calculator
new_enablers.what: Costs any offer before it runs: gross profit per order at the new price or depth, extra orders needed to break even, the new most we can pay per purchase, and the cost of gifts, free shipping and guarantees at expected claim rates. After it runs, reads true lift against a baseline, counting the weeks before and the dip after.
inputs: margin per order and per SKU
powers: break even lift for any discount
new cost per purchase targets after a price change
true sale lift with the dip counted

new_enablers.name: Discount code watch
new_enablers.what: Lists every discount code with who made it, depth, uses, revenue, margin given away, new vs returning buyers, and where the buyers came from. Flags codes that leak to coupon sites and codes that break the discount rules.
inputs: referrer and UTM on each order
powers: share of revenue on a code
